description: Synthetic recall samples in the CPSC Recall REST API field shape (RecallID, RecallNumber, RecallDate, Title, Description, URL, LastPublishDate, NumberOfUnits, Products[], Hazards[], Remedies[]). Every recall, product, brand, and identifier is invented for the fixture-mode validation beta; no real recall or manufacturer is represented. ConsumerContact fields are intentionally absent from the consumed shape.

provenance.limitations: Synthetic fixture data for the validation beta. These recalls do not exist; URLs point to example.com. Never surface as real safety information.
